# pxc_gotify_master (Data Source)

Fetches a proxmox cloud secret, scoped by target_pve, from the postgres px_cloud_secret table.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `mc_peers` (Set of String) List of peers to look for gotify master via their multi cloud gateway.
- `mc_token` (String) Multi cloud token to query the other peers.

### Read-Only

- `gotify_cloud_domain` (String) Cloud domain of the master, this is only different if fetched from a multi cloud peer.
- `gotify_host` (String) DNS Hostname of master gotify
- `gotify_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the default admin user.
